description: Pre-fill a structured CRUD config from an existing schema (OpenAPI JSON, JSON Schema, a sample JSON object, a TypeScript interface/type literal, or SQL CREATE TABLE DDL). Deterministic, no LLM: it maps each property's DATA TYPE to a formtype (integer→InputNumber, boolean→Switch, string+date→DatePicker, string+enum→Select, array+enum→Checkbox, else Input). For ts-interface, JSDoc becomes the label and non-optional members become required; for sql-ddl, COMMENT becomes the label and NOT NULL/PRIMARY KEY become required. Use this as a HEAD START, then review & edit the draft (narrow the query fields, add buttons/dialogs/permissions the schema can't express) and pass it to generate_crud_from_config. OpenAPI YAML is not supported in this version — convert to JSON first.

apiUrl.description: Override the REST base URL, e.g. "/api/users". Defaults to a placeholder you must replace.

name.description: Override the page name (PascalCase). Defaults to the schema title, else a placeholder.

text.description: The schema source text (JSON for openapi/jsonSchema; a JSON object or array for sample-json; TypeScript interface/type source for ts-interface; CREATE TABLE DDL for sql-ddl).

name: ingest_schema
